acceptedAnswer.text: Many disability remodeling modifications, especially those involving structural changes, plumbing, or electrical work, typically require permits in cities like Pacifica and Daly City. Examples include widening doorways, relocating walls, or installing new plumbing fixtures for an accessible shower. Minor installations like grab bars may not, but it's always best to consult with us. We manage the permitting process for your project to ensure compliance with local building codes and regulations, ensuring your renovation is safe and legal.
